caption: The video captures a close-up view of a hydraulic press test, focusing on a polished steel ram ending in a thick cylindrical platen. This heavy metal platen is positioned just above a pile of crushed debris, consisting of reddish-brown shards mixed with gray granular powder, which sits atop a yellow-and-black striped base. The cream-colored machine frame forms the background, with a vertical yellow-and-black measuring ruler along the right edge. The steel platen descends slowly and continuously relative to the base, steadily narrowing the gap above the debris pile. As the platen moves down, the pile of gray powder and reddish shards is gradually pressed lower, and its overall height decreases. Individual fragments shift and tilt a little, most noticeably the flat reddish piece protruding to the right and the gray chunks at the pile's edge. Fine dust at the front of the pile trickles and redistributes slightly as the gradual compression of the crushed sample continues.
relations: The steel platen descends continuously, steadily narrowing the gap above the pile of crushed debris.
As the platen compresses the sample, the overall height of the debris pile gradually decreases.
Compression causes individual fragments, like the protruding reddish piece and gray chunks, to shift and tilt slightly.
The gradual pressing of the sample makes fine dust at the pile's front trickle and redistribute.
